name: io.github.SuperAngryMonkey/kairos
description: Microsoft Planner MCP: create tasks and buckets, list plans and tasks, complete tasks.

environmentVariables.name: KAIROS_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Application (client) ID of YOUR OWN Entra app registration with delegated Tasks.ReadWrite. There is no shared app; you register one.

environmentVariables.name: KAIROS_DEFAULT_PLAN
environmentVariables.description: Plan name used when a tool is called without one. If unset and you have more than one plan, plan= is required.

environmentVariables.name: KAIROS_CONFIG_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where the token cache, audit log and kill-switch file live. Defaults to ~/.config/kairos.
